provider-org.narrative: Partnership for Market Implementation Facility Multi-Donor Trust Fund

title.narrative: Carbon pricing policy dialogues and consultation events convened and facilitated
Communication strategy developed and corresponding communication tools implemented
For international carbon credit trading: Enhanced national carbon asset registry implemented, including connection/linking with at least one international registries
Share of carbon offset project activities submitted for approval to the GoI that have been authorized and are registered in the official national emissions registry
Technical capacity workshops and training events designed and delivered
Carbon pricing implementation roadmap in two priority sectors developed and endorsed
For national emissions trading program: Technical assessment carried out to inform timely policy decisions on enhanced design and further expansion of the domestic ETS
Institutional arrangements are designed, regulated, and implemented to ensure the effective functioning of domestic carbon pricing instruments (ETS and carbon crediting mechanism)
Policy and/or strategy to access international carbon market developed and adopted by MOEF
National Carbon Hub at MoEF and the Carbon Pricing Steering Committee Secretariat at CMMAI established and operational
